claims.claim: At @anthropic-ai/claude-code@2.1.243 / SchemaStore schema generated 2026-04-23, the only required plugin.json field is `name`. All other listed fields are optional.
claims.canonical_mechanism: jsonschema Draft-07 required:[name] plus docs 'If you include a manifest, name is the only required field.'

claims.claim: An unrecognised top-level plugin.json key is NOT a load error under the published SchemaStore schema (root additionalProperties unspecified, Draft-07 default true). Official docs state claude plugin validate reports it as a warning and the plugin still loads. Pre-v2.1.76 runtime strictness (GitHub #20415) is documented as fixed.
claims.canonical_mechanism: unknown key totally_unknown_top_level_field accepted by Draft-07; docs Unrecognized fields section
claims.caveat: SchemaStore is silent (valid=true) rather than producing a warning string; the warning behaviour is documented for `claude plugin validate`, which was not executed here.

claims.claim: Codex HooksFile still carries #[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]. A stray top-level $schema is a hard parse error. description is now a known optional field. The Claude-lenient vs Codex-strict asymmetry recorded in 05-ECO-plugin-specs still holds on 2026-08-25 sources.

The SchemaStore schema ($comment Generated on 2026-04-23T05:09:41.810Z) does not list several keys the 2026-08-25 docs document (displayName, metadata, defaultEnabled, workflows, experimental). SchemaStore lists top-level themes, monitors, and settings that docs place under experimental.* or omit. Because root additionalProperties defaults true, the extra keys still validate. This is version skew between the published JSON Schema and current docs, not a reject.

Verdicts for Claude are from the published SchemaStore schema plus the official docs page captured the same day. If a future runtime Zod .strict() regression returns (issues #20415, #31495, #62400), SchemaStore-valid unknown keys could still fail at load; that would be SOURCE-CHANGED relative to this snapshot.
answer: At @anthropic-ai/claude-code@2.1.243, SchemaStore plugin.json required={name}; all other listed fields are optional. An unknown top-level key is SchemaStore-valid (Draft-07 additionalProperties default true) and docs say claude plugin validate warns while the plugin still loads. Codex HooksFile remains serde(deny_unknown_fields); a stray $schema is a hard error. The 05-ECO Claude-lenient vs Codex-strict asymmetry still holds. Live claude CLI was not executed on this host.
